description: This file defines the ArrayCollectionModel class in the OrangeHRM project, which implements serialization for a collection of data, providing a method to convert internal data to an array.

classes.name: ArrayCollectionModel
classes.description: A class that encapsulates an array of data and provides a method to convert it to an array format for serialization purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with an array of data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the internal data as an array, suitable for serialization.
